Added planet texture exporter. Supports export resolutions up to 16384 x 8192 and can export height, normal and a lit map view. Implemented on the GPU and renders a preview of the planet in real time to an ImGui viewport.
Added ParallelReductionMinMax.comp for quickly finding the min and max values of a texture on the GPU.
Added GenericImGuiViewport class which can create a pannable and zoomable viewport in an ImGui window, useful for something like an interactive planet map or visualization tool.
